title: Sugar House Community Council – November 4th, 2026 Meeting Agenda
why_it_matters: The Nov. 4 Sugar House Community Council agenda includes a DABS construction update on the new Sugar House liquor store and a Fire Station #3 update. It also includes CIP applications, a talk by Dr. Brian Moench of Utah Physicians for a Healthy Environment, and a report from council member Sarah Young.

editor_note: AI-drafted minutes of Snellgrove plan; the Oct. 27 post covers the project better.
headline: Lowe Property Group unveils 325-unit Snellgrove site plan; S-Line on schedule
title: October 7, 2026 – Meeting Minutes
why_it_matters: In the council's own AI-drafted summary of its Oct. 7 meeting, Lowe Property Group's Joe McKay presented 325 market-rate apartments, about 20,000 sq ft of retail, 6,500 sq ft of office space and 510 parking stalls on the 3.25-acre Snellgrove site on 2100 South. The summary says construction would start in summer 2025, which conflicts with the council's later article saying next summer. UTA and Kiewit said S-Line trains will run next summer, with a November track-crossing closure on Highland Drive; the Highland High rebuild is on schedule for fall 2029, and Westminster's new president addressed its past deficits.

details: Council post; topics: News, Public Meeting Review
headline: Developer proposes 325 luxury apartments, retail on vacant Snellgrove site
title: Developer proposes 325 apartments, retail and public atrium for former Snellgrove site
why_it_matters: Low Property Group plans 325 rental apartments, 20,000 sq ft of retail, a public atrium and about 510 parking spaces on the 3.25-acre former Snellgrove parcel on 2100 South near 800 East. The plan is by-right at up to 75 feet, so it needs no council approval, and it includes no income-restricted units. Construction could start next summer; neighbors raised concerns about rents, traffic access and the Snellgrove ice cream sign.

editor_note: Committee report; Zions Bank rebuild is a lead, but the Snellgrove project is covered elsewhere.
headline: Zions Bank site in Sugar House to become apartments; Snellgrove project named Sugargrove
title: SHCC LUZ REPORT 2026 NOVEMBER
why_it_matters: The Sugar House land-use committee's next meeting at Sprague Library will review GEM Sugar House, which would tear down the Zions Bank and rebuild it on the ground floor of an apartment building. The Snellgrove redevelopment is now called SUGARGROVE. The report also says the Planning Commission denied a conditional-use drive-thru in the Sugar House Business District and approved an Affordable Housing Incentives design review process.
